papers.title: Spatial-temporal CO2 concentration prediction in education facilities with dynamic layouts using BIM and multi-modal graph neural networks
secondary_categories: AI and Machine Learning for Buildings

bibliography.title: Spatial-temporal CO2 concentration prediction in education facilities with dynamic layouts using BIM and multi-modal graph neural networks
bibliography.author: Hao Liu and Kam-Ming Mark Tam and Cong Huang and Chun Yin Lai and Eric Schuldenfrei

screening_review.main_claim: BIM由来の時変レイアウトとVoronoiベースのCO2センサ隣接グラフをmulti-modal deep learningで統合し, 2時間先予測でMAE 11.25 ppmを達成し, 比較対象中で次点のTGCNの15.10 ppmより約25%低いMAEを示した.
screening_review.novelty: 静的レイアウトを前提とする既往のGNN型CO2予測に対し, BIMから時変の間仕切り構成をテンソル化し, センサグラフ文脈と空間構成文脈を二枝のMMDLで統合した点に新規性がある.
screening_review.positioning: 教育施設のIAQ予測を主目的としつつ, BIM幾何情報を予測モデルの入力文脈として利用するため, Building Environment and IEQを主分類, AI and Machine Learning for BuildingsおよびBIM and Semantic Informationを副分類として位置付ける.

papers.title: Graph-based spatial–temporal prediction and feature interaction analysis of CO2 and occupant in large indoor space
secondary_categories: AI and Machine Learning for Buildings

bibliography.title: Graph-based spatial–temporal prediction and feature interaction analysis of CO2 and occupant in large indoor space
bibliography.author: Cong Huang and Helen H.L. Kwok and Kwok Ho Poon and Zhaoji Wu and Fangli Hou and Jun Ma and Jack C.P. Cheng

screening_review.main_claim: 提案AST-GCGRUは, 6 hおよび12 hのmulti-step predictionでgraph-level R2 0.898および0.812を示し, GCGRUの0.860および0.699を上回った. 12 hではoccupant node R2 0.59, CO2 node R2 0.73で, GCGRUの0.32, 0.58より高かった.
screening_review.novelty: 距離ベースの固定graphではなく, partial correlationで初期化したgraphをST-Attで学習中に更新し, time-lag nodesにより30 min CO2 sensorと6 min occupant sensorの異なる時間解像度を保持したまま, CO2とoccupancyを同一graphで同時予測・interaction analysisする構成を提示した.
screening_review.positioning: 大空間におけるIAQとoccupancyの同時予測・相互作用分析を主目的とするため, Building Environment and IEQを主分類とし, AI and Machine Learning for Buildings, Occupancy and Human-Building Interaction, Sensors, IoT and Data Integrationを副分類として位置付ける.
